# dual_rmap_node: build brief

Two RMAP nodes, each a subsystem with a SpaceWire port subsystem inside.

This brief was generated by the Open Space Composer from the system file `dual_rmap_node.composer.json` (catalog `0b808376887d`).
The file holds the system as edited (`instances`, `connections`, `externals`), in `resolved` the netlist it resolves to and in `catalogSubset` the catalog entries of its blocks (interfaces, fields, clocks, generics).
Build a VHDL-2008 top level `dual_rmap_node` from `resolved` as described below; everything needed is in the file and in the listed repositories.
The button Export HDL of the Composer, and `tools/composer_hdl.mjs` of the repository of the website, write this top level, its compile order and its constraints from the same netlist (`dual_rmap_node.vhd`, `dual_rmap_node_compile_order.txt`, `dual_rmap_node.xdc`, `dual_rmap_node_top.xdc`, and the address map `dual_rmap_node_address_map.md` with the C header `dual_rmap_node_regs.h`); use them, or build the top level by hand as described here.

**Readiness:** Parts at TRL 3 or higher (lowest: 3). The composed system has no TRL of its own: it is checked by elaboration and a run to 0 ns. The parts are listed in section 15.

## 1. Sources and libraries

Fetch every repository at the given version and compile one VHDL-2008 library per row, in this order:

| Library | Repository | Version | Files | Entities used |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `olo` | https://github.com/open-space-hdl/open-logic-ft | tag `4.7.0-ft.6` (commit `5d8ae56dcd6362f77e5cffc1cf718e605323c1e7`) | every file listed in `compile_order.txt`, in its order | `olo_base_reset_gen` |
| `openwire` | https://github.com/open-space-hdl/openwire | commit `09e4b1f67be8ba0808a267ffdebd1c22c513e861` | every file listed in `compile_order.txt`, in its order | `owr_core` |
| `openrmap` | https://github.com/open-space-hdl/openrmap | commit `e1e13d3ed369c06f3093c745d6b2f8da38d0eba0` | every file listed in `compile_order.txt`, in its order | `omap_core` |

- `olo`: Clone with the submodule 3rdParty/en_cl_fix (git clone --recursive); compile_order.txt lists its files. 4.7.0-ft.6 adds olo_base_chunker and olo_axi_lite_decoder to 4.7.0-ft.2 (ft.3), fixes the error reporting of olo_axi_master_simple and the write word count of olo_axi_master_full (ft.4), the address of transfers that olo_axi_master_simple splits at AxiMaxBeats_g (ft.5), and the transfers of olo_axi_master_full with 8-bit data and narrow addresses (ft.6). Every core of the catalog is verified with 4.7.0-ft.6.
- `openwire`: The submodules of the repository (open-logic, uvvm) serve its own tests; a system uses the olo library of the Composer.
- `openrmap`: The submodules of the repository (open-logic, uvvm) serve its own tests; a system uses the olo library of the Composer.
- One `olo` library (Open Logic FT `4.7.0-ft.6`) serves the whole system. The cores were verified with the Open Logic FT tags `4.7.0-ft.6` (openwire), `4.7.0-ft.6` (openrmap) (`verifiedWith`); their own `open-logic` submodules are not needed.
- With GHDL: analyse Open Logic file by file (`ghdl -a --std=08 -frelaxed --work=olo <file>`), import the files of a core library (`ghdl -i --std=08 -frelaxed --work=<library> <files>`) and let `ghdl -m --std=08 -frelaxed <top>` find the order. `-frelaxed` is needed for Open Logic, whose RAMs use a shared variable without a protected type (`olo_base_ram_sdp`); the cores and the top level also analyse as strict VHDL-2008.
- With other tools follow the order of the table.
- The subsystems `spw_port`, `rmap_node` are entities of this system: compile them into the library of the top level (`dual_rmap_node`) after the libraries above and before the top level, in this order (section 3).

## 5. Constraints

Every clock crossing is an Open Logic block. Between the clocks of a crossing a maximum delay applies in both directions, the period of the faster clock, data path only (Open Logic clock crossing principles). Do not declare these clocks as asynchronous clock groups: in Vivado `set_clock_groups -asynchronous` overrides the delay limits.

- False path through `rmap_node0_spw_port0_spw0_Spw_DIn`, `rmap_node0_spw_port0_spw0_Spw_SIn` (`set_false_path -through` in Vivado: valid whether the port is a device pin or a pin of the system inside a larger design): Inputs that rmap_node synchronises inside.

## 8. Notes from the user guides

**SpaceWire port** (`owr_core`, `spw_port/spw0`): https://openspacehdl.org/openwire/docs/user_guide.html

- LVDS output buffers for data and strobe and LVDS input buffers with fail-safe biasing belong to the top level; the core contains no I/O buffer.
- Enable the safe implementation of state machines in the synthesis tool.
- Set INT_HOLDOFF and INT_ACK_DELAY for the network before distributed interrupts are used.
- Serve the indication ports before the indication FIFO (16 entries) fills.
- Write registers as 32-bit words; a read that depends on a write waits for the write response.

**RMAP node** (`omap_core`, `rmap_node/rmap0`): https://openspacehdl.org/openrmap/docs/user_guide.html

- Rst is synchronous and high-active; synchronise its release to Clk, for example with olo_base_reset_gen.
- M_RepData, M_Conf and M_User must be served when connected; a stalled output stalls the received packet stream and the link.
- RMAP address bits above AxiAddrWidth_g must be zero in the windows.
- With AxiMaxBeats_g = 1 and AxiDataWidth_g = 32 the memory master issues single transfers only and can drive an AXI4-Lite slave; tie M_Axi_RLast to '1'.
- An access longer than one command of the memory master (2^(AxiAddrWidth_g - 2) - AxiDataWidth_g/8 bytes, at most 2^24 - AxiDataWidth_g/8) is split into several commands.

The system is designed for radiation environments together with the triple modular redundancy (TMR) of the synthesis tool, like the Open Logic ft entities its blocks are built on (`resolved.protection`).

State machines recover through their `when others` branch and the reset. All other logic (registers of the control and data paths, counters, pointers, pipeline registers) relies on the TMR of the synthesis tool. The integrator:

- enables the TMR of the synthesis tool for the system,
- checks in the synthesis report that TMR was applied, that the synchroniser chains of the crossings were not triplicated a second time, and that no register-based storage meant to be protected by TMR was inferred as a RAM primitive,
- requests safe state machines, so that synthesis keeps the `when others` branches (AMD Vivado: property `FSM_SAFE_STATE` = `default_state` on the state registers; Synplify: attribute `syn_encoding` = `safe`),
- protects the configuration memory of SRAM-based FPGAs by scrubbing; this is part of the FPGA design.

The ECC paths of the blocks are verified in simulation by error injection. Whether the protection as a whole meets the requirements of a mission is shown by a radiation test of the system in operation.

**`spw_port/spw0`** (SpaceWire port, `owr_core`, in every instance of the subsystem `spw_port`) through the ports `reg_S_AxiLite_*` of `spw_port`:

1. Read ID (0x00): it reads 0x4F575201.
2. Optionally write LINK_SPEED (0x14) bits 7:0 RUN_DIV: the bit period in the Run state in LinkClk cycles (reset value RunDiv_g); choose it for the far end, which samples at most about LinkClk / 1.2.
3. Write PORT_CTRL (0x10) = 0x34 (RECEIVER_EN, DRIVER_EN, LINK_START) to start the link, or 0x38 (AUTO_START) to wait for the far end.
4. Wait for PORT_STATUS (0x18) bits 2:0 LINK_STATE = 5 (Run) before packets are exchanged.

**`rmap_node/rmap0`** (RMAP node, `omap_core`, in every instance of the subsystem `rmap_node`) through the ports `rmap_reg_S_AxiLite_*` of `rmap_node`:

1. Read ID (0x000): it reads 0x4F4D4101.
2. None needed: with the default generics the target accepts every command to the logical address 0xFE with the key 0x00 on the whole address space (WinInit_g). A flight configuration narrows the logical addresses (TGT_LA 0x010), the key (TGT_KEY) and the windows (WIN_BASE, WIN_LAST, WIN_CTRL), see the register map.

## 13. Checks

- Note: No rate data for omap_core (rmap_node0/rmap0, rmap_node1/rmap0): the paths through it are not checked.
- Note: No length limit published for omap_core (rmap_node0/rmap0, rmap_node1/rmap0): packets through it are checked against the other blocks only.

## 14. Verification

A smoke testbench `dual_rmap_node_tb` (VHDL-2008, no extra libraries):

1. Instantiate `dual_rmap_node` and drive `Clk_sys` at 100 MHz, `Clk_link` at 200 MHz.
2. Hold `Rst` at '1' for 16 cycles of the slowest clock (100 MHz), then '0'.
3. Keep every external input idle: stream inputs with valid at '0', ready inputs of external outputs at '1', bus requests idle, pins at '0'.
4. Run for at least 100 us (the blocks initialise their tables after the reset) and stop the simulation: it must end without failed assertions, and the handshake outputs of the top level (valid, ready) and the line outputs must not be 'U' or 'X' after the reset. Data outputs may stay undefined while their valid is '0'.
5. Where an AXI4-Lite port is external, read the ID register of the block (section 12) and compare it with the documented value.

With GHDL: analyse the libraries of section 1, then `ghdl -i --std=08 -frelaxed dual_rmap_node.vhd dual_rmap_node_tb.vhd`, `ghdl -m --std=08 -frelaxed dual_rmap_node_tb` and `ghdl -r --std=08 -frelaxed dual_rmap_node_tb --stop-time=100us --assert-level=error --ieee-asserts=disable` (`--ieee-asserts=disable` silences the warnings of the numeric package about metavalues before the reset).

Optional end-to-end test, after the initialisation of section 12:

- SpaceWire port (`owr_core`): Loop the SpaceWire line back (Spw_DOut to Spw_DIn, Spw_SOut to Spw_SIn) or connect a second port, start the link and wait for PORT_STATUS LINK_STATE = 5 (Run).
